themes.name: Magenta Voltage
themes.description: Neon-drenched energy channeled through sharp material contrasts — hot pink slashing across deep charcoal, every card edge a deliberate cut.

props.text: Hot pink doesn't ask permission. It cuts through charcoal like a laser tag through smoke — every edge deliberate, every card a statement. This is UI as electric event.
Sharp edges. Louder presence. No apologies.

themes.name: Indigo Signal
themes.description: A disciplined information rail channeling Tokyo's neon-against-night geometry — compressed type hierarchy, ink-deep surfaces, and a single amber pulse cutting through monochrome restraint.

props.text: One amber pulse. A city grid compressed into type. This is not decoration — it is signal.

themes.name: Dawncast Concrete
themes.description: Tadao Ando's stillness at first light — warm graphite planes split by a single shaft of gold, where mass and radiance hold equal weight.

props.text: Mass holds its breath. One shaft of gold splits warm graphite at the hour when concrete learns to glow.
Literata carries the quiet — a serif at rest inside the concrete plane.

themes.name: Misty Broadsheet
themes.description: A Swiss-inflected morning journal where ink-gray type floats on mist-washed paper, cards carry the weight through quiet elevation and measured borders, and grayscale imagery colorizes like a photograph developing in morning light.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

props.text: Ink-gray type floats on mist-washed paper. Photographs develop in morning light. The broadsheet never shouts.
Quiet elevation. Measured borders. IBM Plex Sans carries the body text with Swiss precision.

themes.name: Light Through Stone
themes.description: Tadao Ando's Church of the Light recast as graphic poster — raw concrete mass split by a single blade of dawn gold, every surface textured with material weight.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

props.text: A blade of gold cuts concrete. The cross is shadow. The light is the point.

themes.name: Saffron Interference
themes.description: A typographically charged dawn composition where condensed amber headlines crackle against misty morning surfaces — cozy warmth interrupted by one electric surprise.

props.text: Condensed amber headlines crackle at first light — warm fog split by one electric interruption.

themes.name: Amber & Indigo
themes.description: A dawn index card — warm amber light pooling against deep indigo structure, like a Tokyo side street caught between night and morning.

props.text: Dawn pooling on index cards. Tokyo side-street amber bleeding into the last cold hour of indigo night — structured, warm, unresolved.
Source Serif 4 — the body holds its warmth
